folders.intro: For agencies: one folder per client, with its own prospects. If you prospect for your own business, you don't need them.
folders.createDescription: Give this folder a name, for example your client's name.
folders.nameTooLong: The name must be 100 characters or fewer.
folders.nameTaken: A client folder with this name already exists.
folders.quotaReached: Your plan doesn't allow more client folders.
folders.createError: The folder couldn't be created. Please try again in a moment.

list.title: Your campaigns
list.description: A campaign searches Google Maps for businesses in the cities and activities you choose.
list.empty: You don't have any campaign yet. Create one to find your first prospects.

form.citiesDescription: Cities are searched from the most to the least populated.
form.minPopulationHint: Leave 0 to include every city, even the smallest.
form.categoriesDescription: Choose the types of business to search for.
form.categoriesGenericHint: The activities that bring the most results: restaurants, trades, shops…
form.categoriesAllHint: Several thousand activities: more complete, but much slower.
form.filtersDescription: Only businesses matching these criteria are added to your prospects.
form.ratingHint: Google ratings go from 1 to 5. A low rating often means a business that needs help.
form.excludePublicLabel: Exclude public services, banks and chains
form.extraExclusionsHint: Separate words with commas. Businesses whose name contains one of these words are skipped.
form.ratingRange: The maximum rating must be greater than or equal to the minimum rating.
form.mainCategoryOnlyLabel: Only businesses whose main activity this is (recommended)
form.countryLocked: The country can no longer change once the campaign has been launched.
form.editLaunchedHint: This campaign has already been launched. Cities and activities you add will be scanned next; those you remove will no longer be scanned, but prospects already found are kept.

estimate.title: Estimate
estimate.description: Cities and searches to run for your targeting.
estimate.incomplete: Complete the cities and activities to see the estimate.
estimate.creditsHint: Each prospect found uses 1 discovery credit.
estimate.exceedsBalance: Your credits won't cover the whole campaign. It will pause when they run out.

real.title: Prospects on Google Maps
real.intro: Count the businesses matching your criteria by reading Google Maps. Free, no credits used.
real.running: Reading Google Maps: {done} of {total} search{total, plural, one {} other {es}}…
real.exact: {count, plural, =0 {No business matches} one {# business matches} other {# businesses match}} your criteria.
real.exactHint: Measured figure: every search was read.
real.sample: Between {low} and {high} businesses match your criteria.
real.sampleHint: Measured on {sample} random searches out of {total}, then extrapolated.
real.changed: Your criteria changed: run the estimate again.
real.failed: The estimate did not complete. Please try again.

detail.noCreditsDescription: You have no discovery credits left. <link>Top up your credits</link>, then click "Resume".
detail.progressDescription: How far the search has gone.
detail.progressDraft: The search will start when you launch the campaign.
detail.searchesProgress: {done, plural, one {# search} other {# searches}} done out of {total, number}
detail.abandonedHint: Stopped because they brought almost nothing.
detail.latestProspectsDescription: The last 50 businesses found by this campaign.

import.title: Import prospects
import.description: Add your own businesses from a CSV file (Excel or Google Sheets export). Importing doesn't use any credits.
import.fileHint: The first row must contain the column names. Required: a name, plus at least a website, a Google Maps link or a phone number to recognise the business. Optional: email, category, address, country.
import.resultTitle: {inserted, plural, =0 {Nothing added} one {# added} other {# added}}, {duplicates, plural, =0 {no duplicates} one {# duplicate skipped} other {# duplicates skipped}}
import.resultSkipped: {count, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}} skipped because the name was missing, or the website, Google Maps link and phone were all missing.
import.empty: The file is empty or only contains the header row.
import.missingColumns: Columns not found: the file must have a "name" column and at least a "website", "Google Maps link" or "phone" column.
import.noValidRows: No usable rows: each business needs a name and a valid website.
import.folderNotFound: This client folder couldn't be found.
import.failed: The import failed. Please try again in a moment.

errors.campaignLimit: Your plan doesn't allow more running campaigns. Pause one or change your plan.
errors.noCities: No city matches your criteria. Widen the radius or lower the minimum population.
errors.startFailed: The campaign couldn't be launched. Please try again in a moment.
errors.pauseFailed: The campaign couldn't be paused. Please try again in a moment.
errors.updateFailed: The changes couldn't be saved. Please try again in a moment.
